annotations.title: Search ProofPass guides, questions and glossary

description: Use this when someone asks how an EU product rule works or what a document or label must contain: "What must a GPSR label contain?", "Who has to provide a safety data sheet?", "What is the difference between SDS and TDS?", "How long must old versions be kept?". Pass the key words, e.g. "GPSR label". Searches ProofPass’s published guides, questions and glossary (German, English, Polish) and returns title, the short answer, the provision it rests on, the date of the last check and the link. Use for questions on safety data sheets, CLP and UFI, GPSR, construction products, battery and product passport, packaging. When a language has no match, the German library answers and says so. Do not use for one defined term only (get_glossary_term is shorter), for deadlines (use list_deadlines), or for topics outside product documents, chemicals, construction products, GPSR, batteries, packaging and product passports.

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German, default), "en" (English) or "pl" (Polish). Product and account answers are written in German and English; content without a translation comes in German.

query.description: Search words, e.g. "Sicherheitsdatenblatt Sprache" or "battery passport"
